```{python}
#| label: setup
#| echo: false

import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

gas_data = pd.read_csv("weekly_gas_prices.csv", parse_dates=["date"])
```

## Weekly Gas Prices Analysis

The dataset contains weekly gas prices over several years. Below is a plot summarizing the trends in gas prices.

```{python}
#| label: gas_prices_plot
#| code-fold: true

fig, ax = plt.subplots()
ax.plot(gas_data["date"], gas_data["price"], color="blue")
ax.set_title("Weekly Gas Prices Over Time")
ax.set_xlabel("Week")
ax.set_ylabel("Price")
plt.show()
```
